compile_rules: env(name) => PUSH_ENV name with bound_value equal to ENV.bindings[name]
vm_rules: PUSH_ENV name appends the exact signed-64 ENV binding for name and rejects bound_value mismatch
ADD pops b,a and appends a+b iff signed-64 no-overflow
MUL pops b,a and appends a*b iff signed-64 no-overflow
environment_sensitivity: Certificate is valid only for the bound ENV blob. A changed environment must produce a different certificate/target/trace; source identity alone is insufficient.
